mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, we are looking at clear skies at Fireman's Park with a current temperature of 64 degrees and a Waning Crescent moon overhead. Tonight, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 48 degrees, and fortunately, no rain is predicted.

The Verona Common Council has adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This long-range strategy, developed with extensive community input, will guide housing, transportation, and sustainability efforts for the next decade.

Today, you can visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park or enjoy Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out Art House 360 for happy hour and comedy, or join the Hop Haus trivia night.

In a report from the Verona Police Department, on September 28, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash at the intersection of CTH-PB and CTH-M where a 71-year-old driver was cited for failing to maintain control of his vehicle.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant is currently open, so make sure to stop by before they close at 10:00 PM tonight.
